map_notes: FIRIN bakery on the NW corner of block 147. The map tile shows TWO visually distinct zones within the (40) outline: (a) a yellow/wooden zone at the top with the FIRIN label + V.F vault + '2½' storey marker — this is the bakery body itself; (b) a pink/masonry zone below (continuing south into the block) with 'T.R.' + '3 T' — 3 storeys with Turkish tile + sheet metal roof. A chimney for the bakery oven is visible. Primary entrance faces north onto T…L Sokak, secondary entrance possibly on the west onto Sögütlü Çeşme Cad.

zones.description: FIRIN bakery body — wooden frame, French vault ceiling, oven with chimney. Yellow zone on map.
Masonry residential / shop body behind bakery. Pink zone on map with T.R. / 3 T labels.

excel_notes_legacy: Excel v3 wall_code: 'Mg.+VF+MB+2½+TR.4+3.T' — encodes the two-zone split our manual labels now capture. Excel v3 material class = 'C' (wooden) was correct for the north_firin zone only, not the south_body.
